changes.title: Mesh batch h
items: The griffin, sphinx, unicorn, frost wyrm, frost troll, hydra, feathered serpent and stegosaurus are redrawn as low-poly models, like the rest
The hydra's heads now take turns to spit: left, middle, right

changes.title: Shot marks
items: Wild creatures' shots now mark the ground where they land: a brief scorch, frost patch, splash or patch of rough ground in the shot's element. Stand in one for a moment and it hurts or slows you (?shotmarks=0 turns them off, to compare)

changes.title: Mesh batch g
items: The many-legged animals are redrawn as low-poly models on skeletons: fire beetle, woodlouse, tarantula, scorpion and crab, each with its own baby, young, adult and legend, at the sizes they were
They walk on all their legs with their feet planted: the beetle's six go as two tripods, the tarantula's, scorpion's and crab's eight as two fours, and the woodlouse's fourteen in a ripple
The crab scuttles sideways, facing you as it passes, and waves its great claw
The woodlouse rolls into a ball to sleep; the scorpion lays its tail round its side; the others fold their legs in

Their legends wear plate armour cut with glowing runes: a beetle with burning antlers, a fortress of a woodlouse, a tarantula plated in rose glass, a scorpion elder carrying its young, a crab with one colossal claw
